product_context: Chainlink Data Streams API and SDK reference

probes.prompt: How do I integrate with the Chainlink Data Streams API — what interfaces and SDKs are available?

common_hallucinations: Claiming a Python or JavaScript SDK exists (only Go and Rust SDKs are listed)

probes.prompt: Using Go, how do I connect to Data Streams — is there a native SDK?

must_include: Yes, there is a native Go SDK
Authentication is not required when using the SDKs
common_hallucinations: Providing specific Go import paths not shown on this index page
Claiming you must manually authenticate even when using the Go SDK
out_of_scope: Actual Go SDK code and method names

probes.prompt: data streams verify report onchain EVM

must_include: Onchain report data verification for EVM chains
common_hallucinations: Confusing EVM verification with Solana or Stellar verification flows

probes.prompt: Do I need to handle authentication myself if I use the Data Streams SDK, or can I skip it?

must_include: Authentication is not required if using the SDKs
Authentication is only needed for direct API access
Examples available in JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, and Rust
common_hallucinations: Claiming SDKs still require manual API key headers

probes.prompt: I'm building on Solana and need to verify Data Streams reports. What are my options?

must_include: Solana supports onchain integration method verification
Solana supports offchain integration method verification
common_hallucinations: Claiming Solana only supports onchain verification (both onchain and offchain exist)
Applying EVM verification steps to Solana

probes.prompt: Should I use the REST API or WebSocket to get Data Streams data?

must_include: REST API is an HTTP-based interface for simple integrations
WebSocket provides real-time data streaming via a WebSocket connection
common_hallucinations: Stating REST supports server-push/real-time (WebSocket is the real-time option)
Inventing performance benchmarks or rate limits not on the page

# Data Streams Reference

### [API Interfaces](#api-interfaces)

-   [REST API](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/interface-api) - HTTP-based interface for simple integrations
-   [WebSocket](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/interface-ws) - Real-time data streaming via WebSocket connection

### [SDK Integration](#sdk-integration)

-   [Go SDK](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/go-sdk) - Native Go language integration
-   [Rust SDK](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/rust-sdk) - Native Rust language integration

### [Authentication](#authentication)

-   [Authentication](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/authentication) - Learn how to authenticate with the Data Streams API (not required if using the SDKs)
    -   [JavaScript examples](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/authentication/javascript-examples)
    -   [TypeScript examples](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/authentication/typescript-examples)
    -   [Go examples](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/authentication/go-examples)
    -   [Rust examples](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/authentication/rust-examples)

### [Verification](#verification)

#### [EVM chains](#evm-chains)

-   [Onchain report data verification](/data-streams/reference/data-streams-api/onchain-verification) - Verify the authenticity of received data on EVM chains

#### [Solana](#solana)

-   [Verify reports using the onchain integration method](/data-streams/tutorials/solana-onchain-report-verification)
-   [Verify reports using the offchain integration method](/data-streams/tutorials/solana-offchain-report-verification)

#### [Stellar](#stellar)

-   [Verify reports using the onchain integration method](/data-streams/tutorials/stellar-onchain-report-verification)
